_comment: Touge Nights' racers (see docs/modding.md, "racers"): portraits next to this file, painted with Z-Image Turbo.
cars: the kind of car each drives. Kurosawa is the boss of the PassMaster path: he races only for pink slips.

opponents.name: Kenji Mori
opponents.biography: Delivers for his father before dawn and knows every turn of the pass by heart. Says little, drives smoother than anyone his age.

opponents.name: Daisuke Arai
opponents.biography: Swears by the rotary and says so loudly. Fast, flashy, and never lets a pass go.

opponents.name: Yuki Tanaka
opponents.biography: Light car, late braking, no fear. The boys at the lay-by stopped laughing at her roadster a long time ago.

opponents.name: Hiroshi Kato
opponents.biography: Builds turbos for a living and races what he builds. More boost is the answer to every question.

opponents.name: Ryo Sakamoto
opponents.biography: An engineer at the plant by day. Drives the pass like a test programme: measured, precise, relentless.

opponents.name: Takeshi Ono
opponents.biography: Gravel rallyist who brings his four-wheel-drive Celica up the pass when the rally season is over.

opponents.name: Mika Hayashi
opponents.biography: Learnt to drive sideways before she learnt to park. Lives for the drift meets and the crowd's noise.

opponents.name: Shinji Watanabe
opponents.biography: Ran the pass in the eighties and never stopped. Sets up half the cars on the mountain, and beats the other half.

opponents.name: Aiko Shimizu
opponents.biography: Comes up the pass after her shift at the bar, red RX-7, never a word before the start.

opponents.name: Goro Nakamura
opponents.location: The noodle stand at the foot of the pass
opponents.biography: Has driven the mountain for thirty years in whatever was cheap. Slow to anger, hard to pass.

opponents.name: Masato Kurosawa
opponents.biography: The night wind of the passes. Ten years unbeaten downhill, and they say he has never raced for anything but the other man's car.
